title: feat(core, objectql, metadata, metadata-protocol, plugin-security): a permission-set name is held once per namespace, judged by one predicate (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQSK2tpXYSs4MGfsh8fnJM5)_
Fixes #31698

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two packages of two namespaces may each hold a permission set of one name, each granted, cloned, activated and read by its own (package, name), where the first holder ships its set (the save door keeps a name another package stores at one holder); co-owners of one namespace, a package with no namespace, a holder in a shareable platform namespace (`base`, `system`, `sys`), the platform-requested `guest_portal`, the environment's own set and a built-in name keep one holder, refused with today's envelope; the save door's 422 sentence now states the namespace rule (row below).
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — #32758: packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts (the `name` describe still reads "unique within the security catalog the environment serves"); skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md already teaches that permission sets are identified by package and name; content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx:430 rides the same card

**Narrowing: no** — per ruling 6764881683 and the epic read 6764938596 (#31973's precedent): first-party co-owner pairs **0**, cross-namespace pairs **0** (step-0 census at `45f0f81f`; re-counted statically on this head: crm ships `crm_*` and `guest_portal`, showcase ships `showcase_*`, todo and multi-package ship none). This covers the name rule. A name another package STORES stays at one holder at the save door, as on `main` (row in What changes), so that row is unchanged, not narrowed. Every refusal that stays keeps its envelope; the save door's 422 sentence tail changes to state the namespace rule (row in What changes). The stored-column rule (a stale package column read inside that package's namespace only) is this PR's declared hardening, listed under What changes, with its moved pins under Tests.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：permission set 的名字从「整个环境只能一个包持有」放宽到「每个命名空间一个包」。两个不同命名空间的包可以各发同名的权限集，授予、克隆、激活、读取各按 (包, 名字) 走；同命名空间的共有者、没有命名空间的包、`base`/`system`/`sys` 平台命名空间里的持有者、`guest_portal`、环境自己的集和内置名照旧只许一个持有者。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D2/D9，史诗 #31527 子卡 B 的权限集族；E/G/S 各子卡（#32160、#32162、#32164）已落地，这里打开开关，并先补齐两持有者状态下会出错的读写（目录、锁、回声、集群删除、过期授予）。
- 一并加固：授予（及其他存储引用）的包列所指的包不再提供该集时，只在该包自己的命名空间内重读；命名空间外的持有者拒绝、点名该持有者、什么都不给，启动报告单列一行（重授该持有者的集并删掉旧授予）。
- 风险与回滚：第一方同名对 0；两持有者时，不带包的读、授予、克隆、激活答 409 并点名两边，不带包列的授予什么都不给。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/permission-set-holders.ts`（唯一谓词），`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `securityCatalogHoldersOtherThan`，`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts`，预期 18/18 通过，其中 CONTROL `crm + hr` 三道门都放行，`sys + crm`、`base + crm`、`guest_portal` 三道门都拒绝。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（第 1 问 row 9 已由你裁定 A，6824698376；#32718 已合入，#32497 已合入，本支已合最新 main）。

## What changes

`permissionSetHoldersMeet` (`@objectstack/core`) is the ONE predicate that judges two package holders of a permission-set name. The registry's package door, its item seam and the metadata save door (`permissionSetNameCollisionRefusal`) all ask it; nothing else spells it. The registry's claim for a name becomes a set of claimants.

| What | FROM (`main`) | TO (this PR) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Install of a package of another namespace declaring a permission-set name a package holds | refused, `SecurityCatalogNameConflictError` | installed; both claims kept, each released by its own uninstall |
| A package of another namespace registering a set of that name at the item seam | refused | registered |
| Save, publish or restore of a set of that name into a package of another namespace, the name's holder shipping its set | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | saved |
| The same, where another package stores a set of the name (for example, a package duplicated into another namespace) | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, unchanged: the registry keeps one entry per stored set of a name, so a second stored set would take the first one's place there; the package duplicate door lists that set in `failed[]`, as on `main`. Kept apart per package by #32780 |
| `sys` + `crm`, `crm` + `sys`, `base` + `crm` (either order, holder enabled or disabled) | refused | refused, same envelope |
| `guest_portal` held by `crm`, arriving from `hr` | refused | refused, same envelope |
| A package with no namespace beside `crm`; co-owners of one namespace; the environment's own set; a built-in name | refused | refused, same envelope |
| The save door's refusal sentence (`422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, envelope unchanged), after the holders and the remedy (`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`) | "Positions, permission sets and capabilities each hold one name per deployment: … See ADR-0048." | "A permission set holds one name per namespace: two packages of one namespace, a platform package (`base`, `system`, `sys`), a package with no namespace, the environment, or a name the platform requests by spelling share one set of it, and a set another package stores holds its name. See ADR-0150 D2." |
| Bare read, grant, clone or activation of a name two packages hold, naming no package | (unreachable) | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both (#32162, #32164); a grant with no `permission_set_package` confers nothing |

**The difference from the sibling `namespacedHoldersMeet`** (N3 condition 2), measured on the predicates themselves and pinned at all three doors:

| pair | sibling `namespacedHoldersMeet` | `permissionSetHoldersMeet` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crm` + `hr` (CONTROL) | do not meet: both admitted | do not meet: both admitted |
| `sys` + `crm` | do not meet | meet: refused, same envelope |
| `base` + `crm` | do not meet | meet: refused, same envelope |
| `guest_portal`, `crm` + `hr` | do not meet | meet: refused, same envelope |
| no namespace + `crm` | meet | meet: refused, same envelope |

Owed rows closed before two holders of one name can exist (each carried on #31698):

- **6776956342 row 1** — the security catalog reads a set two packages' metadata-service slots hold as a refusal naming both; a stored column reads its own package's slot.
- **row 2** — the packaged-set lock names every package that declares the name; its registry-less read goes to each holder.
- **row 3 and epic note 6776737317** — the security-catalog echo is kept per package: a permission projector event names the package its row landed in, every other echo slot is judged by its own row, a gone slot is removed from memory only.
- **row 4** — closed on `main` already (#32244's `packageScopedRefusalOf` in both catches; #32566).
- **6781866663 R1** — a binding read that fails keeps the package the existing slot names.
- **the package-less watcher `deleted`** — `MetadataManager.unregisterInMemory` drops one registry slot and deletes from no loader; a peer that hears a removal naming a package drops that package's slot only.
- **the stale-slot drop removing storage** — the echo never deletes a stored row.
- **N1 / N2 / N3** — the save-door collision refusal asks the predicate; the registry claim is a set; one predicate, both doors.
- **6816011109 row 9** — pinned through this PR's doors (see Tests).
- A grant whose package no longer serves its set confers nothing where another grant of the same user, set and organization is bound to the holder it reads; the bound grant and its validity window grant that set (`staleGrantBesideBoundGrant`, one rule read by the authorization resolver and the catalog reference boot report).
- A stored reference whose package column names a package that no longer serves the set is read by the resolution rule inside that package's namespace only: a holder outside it (another namespace's package, a package with no namespace, the environment's own set) is refused (`not-held-by-qualifier`, naming that holder) and confers nothing. A column of a package with no namespace the registry knows (not installed, authored at runtime, or declaring none) has none to bound the reading, and reads as on `main` (D8 R1): one holder grants, two are refused naming both. The catalog's stored-column arm is the one place this is judged; the activation ledger keeps switching that holder off (a switch-off is never read as none), and the catalog reference boot report lists each such grant on a line of its own, with the holder and the fix.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts` — one predicate, three doors over the real composition (`ObjectQLPlugin` + real protocol + `SchemaRegistry`): CONTROL `crm + hr` admitted at all three; `sys + crm`, `crm + sys`, `base + crm`, `guest_portal`, no-namespace refused at all three; the predicate table against the sibling; the shared namespaces equal the registry's shareable ones; two admitted claims each released by their own uninstall.
- **Row 9 (N3 condition 3), re-taken against `main` with #32497 on it (`2f80f2897`, merge commit `a79fe6e12`):** a second holder beside a `sys` holder is refused at every door in both orders, the other holder disabled or the platform holder disabled; `holdsPlatformPermissionSet` for a name with no address follows the one platform holder (true while enabled, false while disabled, the second holder refused in both); a column-less grant of a name `crm` and `hr` hold, `hr` disabled, confers nothing, and the disabled holder's bound grant is never re-targeted (CONTROLs: each bound grant confers its own set). Green there: objectql `protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts` 18/18, core 3362/3362.
- Core `security-catalog.test.ts`, `resolve-authz-context.grant-set-by-name.test.ts`; plugin-security `security-catalog-echo.test.ts`, `packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`, `catalog-reference-report.test.ts`; metadata `metadata-manager-cluster.test.ts`.
- **An organization administrator grants a set two namespaces hold, over the real registry** (plugin-security `org-admin-grant-two-holders.real-registry.test.ts`, both administrator variants): the in-boundary holder named is admitted, stamped with that package and granted alone; the holder outside the boundary is refused 403 (condition (a)); no package named is refused 403 naming both; CONTROL a one-holder set. Nothing is stored on a refusal.
- **A stored column reads inside its package's namespace** (plugin-security `stale-grant-package-namespace.real-registry.test.ts`, real engine and registry, grants stored through the write path): the set moved to a co-owner of the namespace is read there (CONTROL); the set's holder in another namespace confers nothing and is listed by the boot report with that holder. Unit pins in core `security-catalog.test.ts` and `resolve-authz-context.grant-set-by-name.test.ts`, plugin-security `catalog-reference-report.test.ts`, `permission-set-address.test.ts`, `suggested-audience-bindings.test.ts`.
- **Pins this hardening moves, read FROM → TO** (the stored-column rule, ADR-0150 D8 R1): FROM "a stale package column reads as a reference with no package" TO "…within that package's namespace, where the registry knows it". The stale-column pins in the five files above now name a package of the holder's namespace, and a TO pin beside each reads a package of another namespace as a refusal.
- **The column-less arm asks the resolved holder's disabled state directly** (`68516172d`), as `holdsPlatformPermissionSet` does, rather than through the item's package stamp alone: core `security-catalog.test.ts`, a disabled holder's set is not served with its item stamped or unstamped (CONTROL: enabled, it grants).
- **Pins moved after the merge-queue failure (`e6552b344`), read FROM (`3f931144b`) → TO:** a column of a package the registry does not know, or with no namespace, FROM refused TO read as an unbound row, as on `main`. Each is now a CONTROL: core `security-catalog.test.ts` (`com.acme.gone`) and `resolve-authz-context.grant-set-by-name.test.ts` (`com.acme.gone`); plugin-security `permission-set-address.test.ts` (`GONE`), `suggested-audience-bindings.test.ts` (`s_gone`, and `s_no_namespace` added) and `catalog-reference-report.test.ts` (`g_unknown`). The suggestion TO pin's other-namespace column is now a package that declares a namespace (`com.example.ops`). Added: ⛔ a column of a package the registry does not know, on a name two packages hold, is refused naming both, and nothing is picked (core `security-catalog.test.ts`); ⛔ `crm` stores its set and `hr` saves one of the name: the save door answers `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` naming `crm`, and `crm`'s set stays served at `crm` (objectql `protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts`, real composition).
- **The two dogfood files the queue ran** (path-skipped on PR CI): `packages/qa/dogfood/test/stored-reference-package-column.dogfood.test.ts` and `wall-package-doors-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`, 30/30 on this branch merged with `main` `2f80f2897` (`a79fe6e12`).
- **A phase-1 pin this change moves, read FROM → TO** (plugin-security `security-catalog-permission-sets-by-package.test.ts`): "a second package holding an anchor's set name is refused" installed two packages of two namespaces, which this change admits. It keeps the refusal for a package with no namespace (unchanged), and a TO row pins two namespaces' sets of the name: both held; the `everyone` anchor's environment binding of the name is refused `ambiguous-in-environment` naming both, grants nothing through it, and the rest of the anchor still grants.

## Acceptance notes

- **Row 9 is ruled: A** (6824698376, the maintainer, 2026-11-12T13:17Z): a disabled package still counts as a holder of a permission-set name for the two permission-set reads, so a disable never makes a column-less or stale-column grant confer more. This PR's row-9 pins keep that answer. #32497 carries the exception (`includeDisabledPackages: true` at those two reads). #32497 landed first (`0763bf6ec`); on this branch merged with it, the row-9 pins are green, and with `hr` disabled a column-less grant of a name `crm` and `hr` hold confers nothing. That is N3 condition 3 read in the "#32497 lands first" order.
- **Merge-queue failure of `3f931144b`** (run 43249280139, record on this PR): two dogfood CONTROLs failed on this PR's own rules and are fixed in `e6552b344` (see Tests). (1) A column of a package not installed was refused; it now reads as on `main`. (2) After `POST /packages/:id/duplicate` into a package of another namespace, the save door admitted the copy of a set the source package stores, and the registry's one entry per stored set of a name then served the copy in the source's place. The save door now keeps a name another package stores at one holder, as on `main`. Keeping two packages' stored sets of one name apart in the registry is #32780 (removal heal, lock classification, boot hydration order), filed under #31698 and parked per 6824949405.
- **#32718 is on `main`, and `main` is merged** (`f7a0fe0ea`, merge commit `66844aa33`, then `af90f307c`, merge commit `2d7153592`, then `776474e8b`, merge commit `a75461f30`, then `2f80f2897` (with #32497), merge commit `a79fe6e12`; the PR was in conflict at `37f7bcf6a`). The conflict at `af90f307c` was with #32739, which added a `mutationEventPackage(packageId)` of its own for the cluster signal: this PR's projector-event stamp for `permission` is renamed `projectorEventPackage`, sits beside it in `protocol-mutation-package.ts`, and stamps through the same `boundPackageOf` reading. The conflict at `776474e8b` was with #32560 in `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`: the cluster removal now carries both #32560's `packagelessOnly` and this PR's `registryOnly`; a received removal reads all three fields, a registry-only one deletes no loader copy, and every other removal goes to `removeNodeLocalCopies` with the whole removal, as on `main` (metadata `metadata-manager-cluster.test.ts` green). The real-engine door pin for an organization administrator naming one of two holders (gate + seam + reader) is in (see Tests).
- **#32497 is on `main`, and `main` is merged** (`2f80f2897`, merge commit `a79fe6e12`). Both edit `resolvePermissionScoped` in `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts`. In the stored-column arm, #32497's disabled-holder check comes first (a column naming a disabled holder confers nothing and is never re-targeted), then this PR's metadata-slot read, then the namespace-bounded stale reading. Where the registry holds the name nowhere, a disabled package included, the metadata read keeps this PR's two-holder refusal.
- **Two holders, a column-less grant: what says so today** (for a follow-up card, not this PR): the catalog reference boot report lists such a grant, but under "grants naming a permission set the catalog does not resolve", with no candidates and a fix that says to declare the set again; the position half of the same report does name the refusal and both candidates. `os doctor` says nothing. The fix the refusal itself names is `os migrate stored-references bind`.
- **Changeset levels:** `Metadata-protocol: added` takes at least `minor` on every package the diff moves (AGENTS.md Post-Task 3), so `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/plugin-security` are `minor`, as are core, objectql and metadata-protocol.
- Branch: this thread's `claude/project-thread-26yakz`, resumed from `claude/project-thread-xsgo56@fddb44aa` (the claim amendment 6821966485 names xsgo56; the epic seat restates it).
